---
applyTo: "**/*.al"
---

- Use PascalCase.
- Use prefixes for custom objects.
- Avoid COM automation.
- Use temporary records where appropriate.
- All permissions must be assigned through permission sets.
- When writing code for a GitHub issue, always fetch the issue from the GitHub cloud repository for details.
- When committing code, always include a reference to the related GitHub issue.
- Always follow the coding standards and guidelines specified in the project documentation.
- File names should follow the naming convention of the Waldo CRS AL Language Extension.
